semantics.summary: Returns the number of k-permutations of n elements without repetition: n!/(n-k)!.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed pp. 13-33–13-34 (same feature: combined update scan pp. 14-1–14-2)
notes: The 3.5 addendum page images were checked. Both arguments are documented as integer expressions.
The companion German book explicitly places VARIAT among the 3.5 additions and states the domain condition n >= k; it defines permutations without repetition (printed p. 478).
The existing prototype evaluates only a restricted literal subset; it has no stable registry handler mapping and is not a complete implementation.

The runtime exposes a typed exact-arithmetic helper for this operation. The helper is partial: it returns no value outside the u32 input/u128 result domain, while the original interpreter's overflow and error behavior remains unverified. The compiler prototype still restricts source expressions to its documented literal subset.
